title: Unisex Birding – Hold On. There's a Bird. Hoodie

seo.title: Bird Hoodie – Hold On. There's a Bird.
seo.description: A funny bird hoodie for the birder who stops for every bird: HOLD ON. THERE'S A BIRD. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

HOLD ON. THERE'S A BIRD. is the bird hoodie for the birder who stops every walk, drive and conversation for a bird, worn to the trail, the feeder window and the Christmas bird count.

HOLD ON. runs across the top in heavy serif capitals and THERE'S A BIRD. fills the bottom, much wider. Between them a black-capped chickadee perches on a pair of old leather binoculars that hang by a woven strap from a pine branch, leaning forward and staring straight out at you with its head tilted.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the bird and branch; Sand gets deep pine green and faded red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a cold morning on the trail?
Yes. The Hold On. There's a Bird. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for early birding walks, cold feeder-watching mornings and long stretches standing very still.

How does the Hold On. There's a Bird. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a flannel. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a birder?
It is a natural one. Every birder has stopped a conversation for a bird, so it lands with feeder-watchers, trail friends and the family who has learned to wait. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the chickadee sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Hold On. There's a Bird. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
